curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As wartime reality displaces her youthful dreams, can she endure the darkest trials of her generation and find a way back from despair?
curatedMovie.description: Based on Vera Brittain’s First World War memoir, this story moves from youthful hopes to despair through love, war, and remembrance.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, thoughtful period drama moving at an engaged, deliberate pace.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by James Kent, this poignant historical drama delivers an intimate, deeply felt perspective on love and the futility of war from a woman living through it.
